Game Overview

In Auto Rickshaw, the core idea is straightforward: brave the vibrant chaos of New Delhi's streets in Auto Rickshaw. Maneuver through traffic, dodge obstacles, and collect coins to unlock exciting new rides. Test your skills with thrilling precision and unlock unique rickshaws in this irresistibly fun arcade adventure.
